contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #033: Iitaka subadditivity, variation, and logarithmic additivity.

Full marked-data setting of prop:tail-rank: a polarized pure integral rational Lie variation with semisimple adjoint connected monodromy, an irreducible compatible complex coefficient representation with whole highest Hodge piece E, any dominant connected-generic-fiber h:W->S, and any compatible algebraic line ell in h*E, on the specified resolved unipotent Hodge extensions.

definitions.Gi: span of all contractions theta^i ell; G0=ell
definitions.Uj: direct sum of Gi for i>=j, extended as resolved tautological subbundles
definitions.H: pullback of det E plus the compatible positive compact-mark line
definitions.nu: numerical dimension of a nef rational line, not Iitaka dimension

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 033 (Iitaka subadditivity, variation, and logarithmic additivity.; papers: Orbifold and logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity; Logarithmic Kodaira dimension and whole-fiber variation; The reverse logarithmic Kodaira inequality and additivity; Projective Hodge lines and ordinary Iitaka subadditivity; B-semiampleness for compact log-smooth Kähler fibrations; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/033.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

For every h and compatible algebraic line allowed in prop:tail-rank, all rational c0,c1>0, cj>=0 for j>=2 and t>=0 give nu(Pc+tH)=nu(Pc)=nu(L0+L1), with nefness of every Lj and exactly the specified resolved unipotent Hodge extensions.

For block-graded sl4 acting irreducibly on itself with highest E=span(e13,e14,e23,e24), x=e13 and s=e24 satisfy x*s=0 and [[x,x*],s]=0, but [[x,e32],s]=e14 and ad(x*)|E has rank 3. Thus a diagonal-only test cannot replace the manuscript universal commutator hypothesis.

A Hodge-generic local fiber T of the algebraic projective flat-line map, with irreducible algebraic closure Z, has a normal restricted monodromy factor H. At suitable smooth points of T its differential on TZ fills the H_C orbit, and the complementary whole rational Lie period is constant on a finite level of Z.

The specified canonical Hodge extensions and resolved tautological subbundles have two-sided power-log norms. Every semipositive rational line metric with the resulting two-sided loglog weights is nef and its maximal curvature rank equals its numerical dimension, by the full mixed-mass identity.

The geometric-vector lattice and zero test, marked actual descent and adjoint bigness, relative-Iitaka section comparison, pseudoeffective threshold, relative pseudoeffectivity, and numerical twist removal hold under their respective manuscript hypotheses. These claims are grouped only as the unverified frontier outside this bounded mission, not asserted proved.

Under the reduced-SNC support inclusion and stratum-smoothness hypotheses of thm:upper-bound, kappa(X,KX+E)<=kappa(Y,KY+D)+kappa(F,KF+EF), including vanishing of every positive pluricanonical space if either right-hand term is negative infinity. This full theorem is not independently verified by the bounded Higgs-tail mission.

For every integrally graded complex semisimple g with compatible compact adjoint, adjoint-stable graded ideal h, and irreducible compatible graded V with top E, and every nonzero s in E, {x in h1 : [x,h_-1]s=0}={x in h1 : x*E=0}. This kernel is the direct sum of degree-one root blocks whose component in Delta0 union {alpha} pairs trivially with the highest weight.

Under the reverse-logarithmic theorem hypotheses, every nonzero total-space logarithmic pluriform gives base logarithmic nonvanishing, and if the base logarithmic Kodaira dimension is zero its zero on an original smooth fiber gives a nonzero positive base pluriform vanishing at that base point. The remaining construction inputs are outside this mission.
For every h and compatible algebraic line allowed in prop:tail-rank, all Lj are nef and nu(sum_j Lj+H)=nu(sum_j Lj), on exactly the resolved unipotent extensions specified in the proposition.

For every polarized complex pure variation on any complex manifold and every holomorphic highest-piece line, on the constant-rank locus of the Gi generated by all Higgs words, ker(Theta_L0+Theta_L1)=intersection_j ker(Theta_Lj)=ker(sum_j cj Theta_Lj) for all c0,c1>0 and cj>=0 otherwise. There is no bound on ranks or tail length, and no algebraicity, irreducibility, or monodromy hypothesis is needed for this local assertion.
On the variation locus, null curvature of L0+L1 implies A*G1=0, A ell=0 and zero projective flat derivative of ell; the compatible compact marks also have zero derivative.

For every h and compatible algebraic line in the full marked-data setting, all Lj are nef. For all rational c0>0, c1>0, cj>=0 for j>=2 and t>=0, Pc=sum_j cj Lj satisfies nu(Pc+tH)=nu(Pc). Only the first two tail curvatures are needed for the null-direction comparison.

assumptions.statement: For a good (graded-)polarizable variation on a smooth connected algebraic variety, connected monodromy at a Hodge-generic point is normal in the derived Mumford-Tate group. Pure polarized integral variations are included.
assumptions.source: Andre, Mumford-Tate groups of mixed Hodge structures and the theorem of the fixed part, Compositio Math. 82 (1992); primary passage obtained by the separate research reader.

assumptions.statement: A connected solvable linear algebraic group acting algebraically on a nonempty complete variety over an algebraically closed field has a fixed point.
assumptions.source: Borel, Groupes algebriques, Bourbaki expose 121, published archive 1956; primary passage obtained by the independent research reader.

assumptions.statement: For a polarized variation on a Zariski open subset of a compact analytic space, the Hodge components of every global flat section are flat. In particular a rational Lie variation with trivial monodromy is constant.
assumptions.source: Schmid, Variation of Hodge Structure: The Singularities of the Period Mapping, Invent. Math. 22 (1973); original-paper scan obtained by the separate research reader.

assumptions.statement: On a compact Kahler manifold with Kahler form omega, if phi belongs to E(X,omega), psi is omega-psh, and phi<=psi, then psi belongs to E(X,omega).
assumptions.source: Guedj-Zeriahi, The weighted Monge-Ampere energy of quasiplurisubharmonic functions, final arXiv version; primary proposition read by engineer.

assumptions.statement: For a simple representation of a split reductive group, the primitive Borel-eigenvector line is unique, its weight is dominant with multiplicity one, and all other weights differ by nonnegative simple-root lowerings.
assumptions.source: Milne, Algebraic Groups, Cambridge 2017, author PDF iAG2017.pdf; primary text read by engineer.

assumptions.statement: For a unipotent polarized variation over a punctured polydisc, the Hodge metric on every order sector is quasi-isometric to a finite multigraded sum of powers of adjacent log ratios and the final negative logarithm, relative to a compatible flat reference metric.
assumptions.source: Cattani-Kaplan, Degenerating variations of Hodge structure, Asterisque 179-180 (1989); theorem text and displayed formula read by engineer.

assumptions.statement: A horizontal section of a regular-singular algebraic flat connection corresponding to a global invariant local-system tensor is algebraic; trivial regular-singular local systems have algebraic flat frames.
assumptions.source: Deligne, Equations differentielles a points singuliers reguliers, Chapter II, Section 6. The IAS source endpoint returned HTTP 403; the primary text was not obtained and this dependency is explicitly uncited.

assumptions.statement: Complex semisimple root systems have connected root support and the root-string property; finite-dimensional root-sl2 theory says a highest vector with zero coroot weight is killed by that negative root. The top graded piece is generated by degree-zero negative roots.
assumptions.source: Standard semisimple root and highest-weight theory; Humphreys, Introduction to Lie Algebras and Representation Theory, Sections 9-10 and 20-21. The exact primary source passages were not obtained; explicitly uncited, not independently attributed.

assumptions.statement: Every algebraic subgroup of a linear algebraic group is the stabilizer of a line in a finite-dimensional representation; every representation of a linear group is constructed from a faithful one by tensors, duals, sums, and subquotients. For a connected semisimple stabilizer the line character is trivial, giving the tensor-vector monodromy reduction.
assumptions.source: Milne, Algebraic Groups, Cambridge 2017, author PDF iAG2017.pdf; primary statements read by engineer.

assumptions.statement: On a compact Kahler manifold, a closed positive (1,1)-current with zero Lelong numbers has nef cohomology class, by smooth regularization with arbitrarily small negative part.
assumptions.source: Demailly, Regularization of closed positive currents and intersection theory (1992), zero-Lelong regularization consequence (cited in the manuscript as Corollary 6.4). Author endpoints timed out and author-posted mirror returned HTTP 403. The purported web-search quote was not accepted as a primary reading; explicitly uncited dependency.
